---
title: "The Impact of the Pandemic and Energy-Food Shocks on European Consumers' \"Everyday Spending\""
date: 2026-05-18
categories: [Working paper]
description: "A new OECD dataset of monthly card spending for 12 countries traces how \"everyday spending\" shifted through the pandemic and the energy/food price shocks."
---

New OECD Working Paper, with Sebastian Barnes and David Haugh ([OECD Economics Department](https://www.oecd.org/en/about/directorates/economics-department.html)) and Luis Monteiro and Sidharth Goel ([Mastercard Economics Institute](https://www.mastercard.com/global/en/news-and-trends/insights-report/mastercard-economic-institute.html)):

Built from a new high-frequency dataset of aggregated, anonymised Mastercard transaction data — monthly spending across 12 European countries and 9 categories from 2018 to 2024 — the paper tracks "everyday spending," the part of consumption closest to households' day-to-day lives. It finds a strong post-pandemic recovery followed by a marked slowdown since 2022, with poorer regions hit hardest by the squeeze on essentials like food and energy.
